sources.title: HEIDENHAIN TNC 640 User's Manual ISO Programming (ID 892909)
HEIDENHAIN TNC 640 User's Manual Programming of Machining Cycles (ID 1303406)

native_language_and_iso_mode.value: Native = HEIDENHAIN Klartext, a dialog-guided conversational language (file type .H) - it is NOT G-code (blocks like 'L X+10 Y+5 FMAX', 'CYCL DEF 200'). ISO programming is a second, separate format (file type .I). No mode-switch code: the program format is fixed by the file type, and the program editor handles .H and .I files. An ISO program begins with '%<name> G71 *' (mm) or G70 (inch).
native_language_and_iso_mode.where: 3.1 p. 66 (Klartext and ISO); 3.5 p. 93; file types p. 123; .I call p. 253

program_open.value: %<NAME> G71 *  (first block: %, program name, unit of measure G71 = mm / G70 = inch). Control generates it automatically when a new program is created. Typically followed by blank form G30/G31 blocks (only needed for graphics).

program_close.value: N99999999 %<NAME> G71 *  (last block: N99999999, name, unit). Preceded by M30 or M2 (M30 same as M2: stop, spindle stop, coolant off, return to block 0).
program_close.where: 3.5 p. 93; example p. 63; M table 7.2 p. 229
program_close.note: Example on p. 53 omits the '%' in the last block ('N99999999 BSPCONT G71 *'); all others include it.

comment.value: ';' starts a comment to end of block (comment may follow the NC words or be a whole block; a commented-out block starts with ';'). Last character of a comment block must not be '~'. Parentheses are not comment characters in H1.

line_numbers.value: Required: every block carries N + number (control numbers automatically with machine parameter blockIncrement no. 105409). Last block is N99999999.

block_end.value: '*' at end of block (address table: '*' = End of block). Cycle-definition blocks span several lines of Qnnn=value ;COMMENT.

safe_start.value: G71 in the program-start block (mm); G17 in the T block (tool axis Z / plane XY); G90 absolute; G40 radius comp off. Example start: 'N40 G00 G40 G90 Z+250 M3*'. No G94 (feed is always mm/min in mm programs), no G49 (length comp is automatic), no G80 (G80 = WORKING PLANE cycle).
safe_start.where: p. 53 layout; G overview pp. 627-632; feed p. 126; length comp p. 137

tool_change.value: Tool call block: T<n> G17 S<rpm> [F..] [DL.. DR..] *  e.g. 'N30 T5 G17 S4500*', 'N20 T 5.2 G17 S2500 DL+0.2 DR-1*'. No M6: the T block runs the tool-change macro. G51 preselects next tool. T may be a number, a name in quotes, or Q param.
tool_change.where: Tool call p. 133; tool change p. 134; S in T block p. 127; example p. 63

tool_length_comp.value: Automatic from the tool table as soon as the tool is called; cancelled by calling a tool with L=0 (e.g. T0). DL in T block adds a delta. No H word.

spindle.value: S rpm in the T block (S-only T block changes speed only); M3 CW, M4 CCW, M5 stop; M13/M14 = spindle + coolant on.

work_offset.value: No G54-G59 slots. Workpiece datum comes from the preset table (activated with G247 PRESETTING, cycle 247); datum shift by values with G54 (cycle 7 DATUM SHIFT) and from a datum table with G53 (# = datum number).
work_offset.where: 7.2 Cycle 7 p. 229; 7.8 Cycle 247 p. 243; H1 address table p. 633 ('# Datum number with G53'), G overview p. 628
work_offset.note: G54 here means 'shift by X.. Y.. Z..', not 'select offset 1' as on Fanuc.

arc_format.value: Circle center set first with I J (K) as a separate, modal definition (absolute coordinates; incremental relative to last position if entered incrementally; G29 takes last position); then G02/G03 X.. Y.. moves to end point around it. Alternative: G02/G03 X.. Y.. R.. (R>0 arc < 180 deg, R<0 > 180 deg; full circle = two semicircles). G05 = last direction.
arc_format.where: pp. 162-166 (Circle center I, J; arcs G02/G03/G05)

rapid_linear.value: G00 rapid (non-modal with respect to feed: after the G00 block the last numeric F is active again); G01 linear at F.

feed_word.value: F in mm/min in mm programs (1/10 inch/min in inch programs); may be in T block or any positioning block; modal.

decimal_point.value: Values are written with sign and optional decimal, e.g. X+100, Z-40, R+20, DL+0.2; manual examples use whole numbers without point as mm (blank form 'Z-40' with 0.1 mm minimum dimensions).
decimal_point.note: No explicit statement found that a value without a point is mm (inferred from examples); no implicit-decimal mode described.

max_digits.value: Cycle inputs up to 4 decimals (e.g. Q201 -99999.9999..+99999.9999); arc radius max 99.9999 m.
max_digits.note: General axis-word digit limit not stated.

retract_home.value: M91 in a positioning block = coordinates referenced to machine datum, e.g. G00 Z.. M91 (tool length not applied); M92 = machine-builder preset. Non-modal, act at start of block. No G28 (G28 = MIRRORING cycle).

coolant_mist.note: M7 not listed in H1 M table; machine-builder.

dwell.value: G04 with F = dwell time in seconds (cycle 9 DWELL TIME, ISO G04; 0..3600 s, 0.001 s steps). Also FUNCTION DWELL TIME<s> / REV<n>.
dwell.where: 13.2 Cycle 9 p. 420; H1 address table p. 633 (F = dwell time with G04); H1 10.17 p. 403
dwell.note: Exact ISO block (e.g. 'G04 F1.5 *') not printed in either manual; form assembled from the address table.

drill_G81.value: G200 DRILLING (cycle 200), defined then called: G200 with Q200 set-up clearance (incr), Q201 depth (incr from surface, negative), Q206 plunge feed mm/min, Q202 plunging depth, Q210 dwell top s, Q203 surface coordinate (abs), Q204 2nd set-up clearance, Q211 dwell at depth s, Q395 depth reference. Called with M99 on a positioning block (once) or M89 (modal), or G79. Simple single-feed drilling = Q202 >= depth. Fanuc G81: Not available: the TNC 640 ISO function list has no Fanuc-style canned cycle G73/G81-G85; G-numbers there mean other things.
drill_G81.where: 4.2 pp. 76-79; calling p. 50; H1 example p. 63, G79 p. 632

dwell_drill_G82.value: G200 with Q211 dwell at depth (seconds), or G240 CENTERING.

peck_G83.value: G200 (Q202 plunging depth, full retract to set-up clearance each peck) or G203 UNIVERSAL DRILLING / G205 UNIVERSAL PECKING.

chip_break_G73.value: G203 UNIVERSAL DRILLING with Q213 breaks / Q256 retract distance for chip breaking, or G205 with Q257 infeed depth for chip breaking + Q256.

rigid_tap_G84.value: G207 RIGID TAPPING: Q239 pitch (sign = hand, + right), Q201 thread depth, Q203, Q204; feed derived from S x pitch, no F needed. G206 = floating holder (Q206 feed = S x p mm/min). G209 = with chip breaking.

bore_ream_G85.value: G201 REAMING (Q206 feed in, Q208 retract feed, Q211 dwell). G202 BORING.

return_level_G98_G99.value: No G98/G99 (G98 = set label). Retraction per cycle: Q200 set-up clearance and Q204 2nd set-up clearance.

cycle_cancel_G80.value: No cancel code needed: M99 calls a cycle once; modal M89 is cancelled by M99 or by defining a new cycle. G80 = WORKING PLANE.

notes: Klartext (conversational, .H) is not G-code and is out of scope for a G-code post; only ISO (.I) is described here. Several G numbers collide with Fanuc meanings: G28 mirroring, G43/G44 radius-comp extend/shorten (NOT length comp), G53/G54 datum shift, G80 working plane, G98 label, G99 tool definition, G4 dwell cycle, G291 a turning cycle. TNC 620 and TNC7 manuals were not fetched: memory says TNC 620 ISO is the same format and TNC7 also accepts ISO programs, unverified.
